_about: F41: the end report's payslip (design/story.md "Credits, payday and fines"; sketch S8 approved). Fines are theatre: the report shows a gross a bit higher than the shift earned, then fines that bring it back down, so NET always equals the real XP. Payday = each rank-up: the Company takes exactly the payment due (that rank's xpToNext), itemised. Words: content/text/en.json payslip.
_fineShare: Fines total = this share of the shift's real XP (0.08 = 8%), rounded. 0 = no fines.
_fineLines: How many fine lines a shift shows (fewer if the total is tiny). The shift's real events are picked first, then silly ones.
_lineMs: How long each payslip line waits before the next one shows (ms).
_loiterSeconds: Seconds at the console in one shift before 'Unscheduled console loitering' becomes a real fine.
_caughtRank: F40: the rank the Veteran is caught at (design/story.md, moment 30). The first shift report at or after it fines YOU once: 'Association with a retired employee' (always the first fine line). Paydays from this rank on use the after-capture words (en.json payslip.afterCaught): the economy doesn't change, the words do.
_pendingRetirementRank: F63: from the shift that reaches this rank, every end report has a last row 'Pending retirements: Operator #4471 — <your name>' (design/story.md moment 39: '…your name… is on a list…'). Words: en.json payslip.pendingRetirements.
_sillyFines: Silly fines (words: en.json payslip.silly) and the rank each starts at.
_payday: Each payday's deductions as shares of the payment due (they add up to 1). 'extra' rotates through en.json payslip.extras, one per rank.
_debt: Passage debt (story only, never touches play). Starts at start; each payday pays paidShare of the payment due off it and adds interest (min..max, the same every time for a rank). From afterRank on, interest is × afterMult and nothing gets paid off, so it goes UP.
